title: Match the selected Git ref exactly before interpreting exchange observation output
outcome: Match the selected Git ref exactly before interpreting exchange observation output
acceptance: Observation consumers select only the exact requested ref field and cannot confuse a tail-colliding ref with that branch; a local owned regression covers refs/heads/main and refs/heads/foo/refs/heads/main.
Zero or duplicate exact matches have an explicit result/refusal contract, and raw protocol output is documented at the adapter boundary.
